content.short: kycDAO is a multichain platform for issuing reusable, on-chain KYC verifications.
content.description: kycDAO offers a widely interoperable, Web3-native approach to compliance through KYC NFTs. These tokens provide verifiable identity signals that can underpin governance participation, founder verification, and eligible investments and fundraising activity within decentralized ecosystems. When a user holds multiple wallets, they can mint the KYC NFT across all of their wallets, ensuring a consistent identity snapshot. Once issued, KYC NFTs can be reused across compatible services and networks for any length of time, enabling ongoing use without renewal requirements.
